summary: Adds Task as a first-class PLATE issue type for human-only blockers and requested human action items.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repositories should add the Task label, the Task issue template, updated issue-type enforcement, and the Task closure marker rule.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy the updated .github/labels.yml, .github/workflows/label-check.yml, and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.yml into your repository.
2. Update AGENTS.md and .agentic/process.yml so Task is treated as a first-class issue type with milestone inheritance but no required Epic label.
3. Allow Task issues to close with a completion comment containing <!-- PLATE-TASK-CLOSED --> instead of requiring a PR, unless repository truth changed.
agent_notes: Use Task for human-only blockers or explicitly requested human action items. When closing a Task, add a short visible completion note plus the <!-- PLATE-TASK-CLOSED --> marker and avoid leaking secrets.
